issue.title: test: add offline schema and format validation for Shields statistics JSON (#55)
issue.body:
## Summary

Adds comprehensive offline unit tests in `tests/test_repository_stats.py` to validate the Shields endpoint JSON payload files (`code-lines.json`, `files.json`, `directories.json`) generated by `scripts/repository_stats.py`. Tests verify key sets (`schemaVersion`, `label`, `message`, `color`), exact value types, numeric formatting, newline termination, and CLI invocation with temporary output directories.

## Related issue

Closes GotUrBack-Public/MForce-Enhanced-Framework#55

## Testing and evidence

- [x] `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v`
- [x] `git diff --check`
- [ ] Termux tested (device/version): Not applicable (test addition)
- [x] Linux tested (distribution/version): POSIX Python test environment
- [ ] Website checked for keyboard, mobile and reduced motion (if applicable)
- [x] Not applicable / not tested: Website and shell modules untouched

**Actual test results and limitations:**
```
test_cli_main_generates_valid_statistics_files (tests.test_repository_stats.RepositoryStatsTests) ... ok
test_counts_are_based_on_tracked_files_only (tests.test_repository_stats.RepositoryStatsTests) ... ok
test_nested_directories_are_counted_once (tests.test_repository_stats.RepositoryStatsTests) ... ok
test_shields_endpoint_json_format_in_output_directory (tests.test_repository_stats.RepositoryStatsTests) ... ok
test_shields_endpoint_payloads (tests.test_repository_stats.RepositoryStatsTests) ... ok
Ran 5 tests in 0.163s - OK
```

## Security, privacy and compatibility

- [x] I used only owned/authorized targets.
- [x] No credentials, personal data or private scan logs are committed.
- [x] New network calls have bounded timeouts, scope and output. (Zero network calls; tests use synthetic temporary directories)
- [x] New data flows or external services are documented in `DSGVO/`. (None)
- [x] I reviewed relevant licensing and attribution.
- [x] Module registration, permissions and README commands are updated. (README.md unchanged per issue instructions)

## AI assistance

AI pair programmer assisted with formulating the test fixtures and CLI invocation tests in `tests/test_repository_stats.py`. All code was manually verified locally.

## Reviewer notes

None. Focused, offline, deterministic test enhancement.
